subject: legend titles in an interactive plot

messages.author: 7dca01938cf07aef
messages.subject: legend titles in an interactive plot
parts:
Just started using ggvis - very nice!  I'm wondering if there is a way to have a legend title respond to the interactive portion of a plot.  For instance, if fill colour is selected with input_select the legend title is "reactive_" with some number.  I'd like to have it match the appropriate variable.  Here's a quick example.

 mtcars %>% ggvis( x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, fill = input_select(c("cyl", "carb"), map = as.name)) %>%
  layer_points()

Thanks so much!

Matt

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: legend titles in an interactive plot
parts:
Sorry, at this point, the legend title can't be dynamic, because Vega doesn't support it.

-Winston
